top_strength: Danah gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently (property type, size, walking distance, special items, box count, parking) and anchored the estimate with both a typical range and personalization to this customer's straightforward move.
coaching_note: Critical gap: Section 2 (Their Concerns) was entirely skipped — rep moved straight into logistics probing without ever asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?', and Section 5 (Two Promises) and Section 7 (explicit ask) were both omitted, leaving no opportunity to close or secure the booking with a clear ask for the business.
